'''{{PAGENAME}}''' {{Lang|zh=椋羽}} is a quest-exclusive NPC that first appears with '''[[Zaochun]]''' in {{Quest|The Wind Before the Storm}}. 
__NOTOC__
{{Dialogue Start}}
==Idle==
:'''Zaochun:''' What about those from the Ministry of Foreign Affairs?
:'''Qilu:''' With the lockdown lately, there was only a small crew left...

==Dialogue==
:'''Zaochun:''' What about those from the Ministry of Foreign Affairs? I thought we put out a notice for everyone to pull back?

:'''Qilu:''' With the lockdown lately, there was only a small crew left on duty to keep the Skywatch Rings running.

:'''Qilu:''' Honestly, if they hadn't switched the monitors to safety mode, we wouldn't even be able to see the data right now with the comms jammed.

:'''Qilu:''' But... because they stayed behind to do that, a few of them missed their chance to evacuate.

:'''Qilu:''' By the time we got there... it was already too late.
{{Dialogue End}}
